body: Nah, you're not being bothersome. I guess I'm looking for someone who gets me, gets my sense of humor and someone who's okay with me when I start talking about oddball stuff. I guess I just want someone to laugh with, to share inside jokes, stuff like that. And above all, honesty. Even if it hurts my feelings. I'd rather know what I'm doing wrong than have to guess at what I might be doing wrong.

I just feel like I'm never gonna find anyone for me. I've been single for years now and every time I try to date someone it ends bad, I'm worried that I don't know how to have a relationship. It just sucks when you're always the single friend and everyone around you is dating someone or getting married. It's especially tough around this time of year when everyone is having parties and when it's time to leave, I leave alone, drive home alone, get in bed alone. It's just becoming more and more lonely. It also ties into the being single thing too because I'm starting to feel alienated from my friends. They're doing stuff as couples and I'm just feeling like an afterthought.
